business.description: Avon Mercantile Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with RBI under Section 45-IA, engaged in providing inter-corporate deposits, short-term loans and advances to group companies, and investment activities. The company does not accept public deposits.

outlook.statement: The Company intends to continue the same line of business in future as well. The company has always initiated bold moves to become a multi-product company to assuage regulator concerns over concentration risk inherent in the mono-line business model.

The management expects to sustain this positive trend by continuing its focus on inter-corporate deposits, short-term lending and prudent deployment of surplus funds among its group companies, while maintaining a cautious approach given the Company's limited scale of operations as a Base Layer NBFC.

risks: Concentration risk inherent in mono-line business model
Concentration risk (lending largely confined to group companies)
Credit risk of delay or default in repayment
Liquidity risk given its limited asset base as a Base Layer NBFC
Regulatory risk from changes in RBI or SEBI norms
Interest rate risk on borrowings and loans
